item.title: Zelenskyy rallies EU support as Trump escalates criticism over Ukraine's oil refinery strikes
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday rallied European Union support in Brussels as his relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump deteriorated sharply. item.title: Ship attacks near Hormuz hit record high as oil exports slow; Iran says strait will reopen if US leaves region
item.description: Ship attack reports in and around the Strait of Hormuz have reached a record high, with 12 vessels targeted between Oct. 5 and Oct. 11 — the highest weekly total since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began and up from 10 the previous week, according to BBC Verify analysis of UK Maritime Trade…

item.title: Targeted ads delivered zero-click spyware to Al Jazeera devices, Citizen Lab finds
